# CoSec

> Multi-tenant, reactive security framework for Spring Boot (WebFlux, MVC, Spring Cloud Gateway). IAM-style JSON policies and role-based app permissions, evaluated deny-first across global, principal and role layers; JWT authentication; Redis-backed policy storage via CoCache. Kotlin, Java 17, Spring Boot 4, Project Reactor.

Key facts: a DENY matched in any layer overrides any ALLOW; unmatched requests are denied (IMPLICIT_DENY); errors deny. Anonymous denials return 401, authenticated denials 403, rate limits 429. Policies are JSON with `action` (path patterns) and `condition` (single-key objects such as `{"authenticated":{}}`).

## Guide

- [Introduction](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/introduction): concepts (principal, tenant, policy, statement, app permission), the decision model, modules and their Gradle capabilities
- [Quick Start](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/quick-start): Gradle capabilities, configuration, first policy, issuing tokens
- [Policies](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/policies): policy language reference (actions, templates, conditions and request parts, rate limits, evaluation order, roles and app permissions, loading, OpenAPI generation, validating policies in tests)
- [Configuration](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/configuration): every `cosec.*` property with defaults
- [Authentication](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/authentication): JWT claims, login, refresh, revocation, multi-tenancy, social login, the gateway trust boundary
- [Web Integration](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/web-integration): adapters, status codes, accessing the security context, client IP, request attributes (ipRegion, gateway route id), CORS
- [Operations](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/operations): Redis failure modes, auditing, OpenTelemetry, deployment, performance
- [Troubleshooting](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/troubleshooting): diagnosing 401/403/429/500, policies with no effect, unexpected allows, rate limits

## Architecture

- [Overview](https://cosec.ahoo.me/architecture/overview): modules, request path, decision algorithm, invariants, caching
- [Extending](https://cosec.ahoo.me/architecture/extending): custom matchers (SPI), authorization and context hooks, audit sinks
